sentences.en: He noticed that this drug seemed to inhibit bacterial growth.
sentences.zh: 他注意到这种药物似乎抑制了细菌生长。

sentences.en: My neighbor had his feet amputated due to a bacterial infection.
sentences.zh: 我的邻居因细菌感染而截肢。

sentences.en: The plasmid and the nucleoid are bacterial components that contain DNA.
sentences.zh: 质粒和核区是含有DNA的细菌成分。
